What We Offer

Every table tells a story

I.

Custom Charcuterie Boards

An artful selection of premium meats, artisanal cheeses, seasonal fruit, crackers, nuts, olives, jams, and sweet treats.

II.

Grazing Tables

Beautifully styled on-site with premium meats, artisan cheeses, fresh fruit, vegetables, crackers, breads, dips, and garnishes.

III.

Brunch & Dessert Boards

Sweet or savory spreads built for showers, birthdays, and morning gatherings.

IV.

On-Site Catering

Full-service catering for weddings, corporate events, and holiday gatherings — grand celebrations, grazed to scale.

V.

Delivery & Setup

We deliver, style, and set the scene so all you have to do is gather your guests.

VI.

Custom Theming

Holiday and event-specific styling to match your celebration, season, or color palette.

On the Road

Made to gather. Made to graze.

Catch us at festivals, weddings, and private events with our fully branded mobile grazing trailer — beautiful boards and unforgettable moments, wherever the gathering is.
